calculation.description: Contrarian five-day return, with signal magnitude doubled during lagged VIX stress regimes. VIX is observation-only and is never traded; the regime indicator is lagged one day to avoid look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC/ICIR were positive in 2020-2022 (+0.048530/+0.134401; 770 dates), 2023-2024 (+0.031216/+0.087215; 516 dates), and 2025-2027 (+0.033100/+0.096634; 575 dates). Daily gates are met; predictive power decays materially by 10 days.
validation.methodology: Daily cross-sectional Spearman IC over all available tradable benchmark instruments; observations require at least 8 valid instruments. Forward returns use close-to-close pct_change(h).
